proposition: In the R. Ḥurūf Ibn Turka divides lettrists into those concerned with the letters' occult properties (ahl-i khavāṣṣ, the majority, chiefly al-Būnī) and those concerned with their underlying realities (ahl-i ḥaqāyiq), and declares that his own purpose is to present the principles of the second group.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
